steps.title: An agent picks up your order
steps.body: Your items, quantities and any trade-in estimate are already attached — you won’t be asked to repeat yourself.

steps.title: They message you on WhatsApp
steps.body: Usually within a couple of hours during business hours, on the number you gave us.
